verdict.rationale: Superset lets users delegate tasks to AI agents directly inside the product via a prompt-first flow ('describe the task, pick an agent, and create... the agent starts working on your prompt immediately') and supports many integrated agents (Claude Code, Codex, Amp, Gemini, OpenCode, Cursor Agent), with statuses, diff review, and orchestration skills. However, this is not a single native/proprietary built-in assistant — it's an orchestration layer around third-party CLI agents that the user must have installed/configured, and community feedback (superset-comm-2) confirms it's 'terminal-centric' around external agent sessions rather than a bundled assistant. Missing for 10: a first-party proprietary AI assistant built into the product (independent of external CLI tools), and independent evaluation of assistant response quality itself.
